name: render nf watch content within nf-widget
summary: The nf-pi extension must maintain persistent detail:RenderDetail state that controls the rendering detail level displayed in the nf-widget IView. This detail level is adjustable (e.g., via keyboard input in watch mode) and determines how much information is shown: Cell (-1), Row (0), or All (1).
